Fethiye vs. Other Operators — Price Comparison

Street agents in Fethiye may quote $80-100, but beware of hidden costs:

  • 🚩 Mountain fee NOT included ($45 extra at the gate)
  • 🚩 Short flight from low takeoff (1,200m vs 1,960m)
  • 🚩 Photos charged separately ($50-80 extra)
  • 🚩 Minimal or no insurance coverage

Compare the total cost and you'll see that SkyHigh's all-inclusive price is the best value. Check our FAQ for common questions about pricing.
